remarks: Welcome to Linden House - a true Stamford gem. This 1 bedroom, 1 bath first floor condo offers so much space drenched in nature light. Enter right into the unit through your convenient kitchen door steps away from the parking lot. Be wow'd by a modern kitchen with updated cabinets, granite countertops, subway tile backsplash, SS appliances: gas range, fridge, dishwasher. The kitchen is open to your dinning room and large living room which are both drenched in sunlight. Hardwoods throughout the entire unit elevate the space. The bathroom is nicely updated with modern finishes. Large spacious bedroom with deep closet Deep closets around every turn - help keep you organized. More storage space offered with a cage unit in basement of building. Laundry Room located in separate building. Linden House Condo Common Charges INCLUDE: Heat and Hot Water. 1 Deeded Parking Spot with unit. Current tenant in place until April 2025 paying $2,000 per month. Investor Friendly Complex
